verdict.rationale: The Agent Toolkit and MCP server let AI agents/developers issue plain-language commands to manage invoices, payment links, and other Visa Acceptance operations ('helps developers and non-technical users to work with AI agents using plain language — no coding required'), and the toolkit is confirmed live on npm. However, this natural-language layer is scoped to the developer-facing toolkit for building payment/commerce agents, not a general NL interface for end-users to directly operate core Intelligent Commerce functions (enrollment, mandates, credential retrieval) — those remain structured REST APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over the core payment/mandate/authentication APIs themselves, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the NL toolkit's reliability beyond vendor docs.
